extName.description: The extension's name, shown in the browser toolbar and extensions management page.

extDescription.message: Blocks ads and trackers, and silently closes popup/redirect tabs, without nag screens.
extDescription.description: The extension's short description, shown on the extensions management page and store listing.

popupOnboardingCard.message: Moat blocks ads and trackers automatically. Use the switch below to pause it on a site, or Settings to fine-tune.

popupBudgetNotice.message: Some filter lists are off. The browser's shared rule limit is full.

popupProtectionNone.message: Nothing to block on this page

popupOverrideFingerprintSub.message: Makes your browser look slightly different each visit, so sites can't recognize you.

popupOverrideCookieBannerSub.message: Automatically clicks “reject” on cookie pop-ups for you.

popupOverrideFeedAdsSub.message: Hides sponsored and promoted posts as you scroll.

popupOverrideSeoSpamSub.message: Hides search results from a list of known low-quality sites.

popupPausedSuffix.message: . Reload the page to see it unblocked.

popupLoadError.message: Couldn't load status. Try reopening the popup.

popupReportError.message: Couldn't open the report page. Try again.

optionsTagline.message: Blocks ads, trackers, and hijacked popups.

optionsMasterToggleHint.message: Turn all blocking on or off, everywhere.

optionsCookiesToggleHint.message: Stops sites following you from one website to the next.

optionsWebrtcToggleHint.message: Stops pages finding your real IP address through video-call features, even behind a VPN.

optionsFingerprintRotateToggleLabel.message: Use a new disguise each time you restart

optionsGrayscaleToggleHint.message: Video ads that can't be blocked are grayed out while they play.

optionsFeedScanToggleHint.message: Removes sponsored posts from Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube feeds.

optionsConsentRejectToggleHint.message: Answers consent pop-ups for you, sharing as little as possible.

optionsCnameChromeDohHint.message: On Chrome, this checks disguised trackers using Cloudflare's public lookup service. It may miss the very first one it finds, then catches every one after that. Firefox does this itself, more privately, and catches every one from the start.

optionsExceptionsHint.message: Moat is off on these sites. To pause one, click Moat's icon while you're on it and flip the switch.

optionsFilterBudgetWarning.message: Some of Moat's filter lists couldn't turn on. Browsers limit how many blocking rules extensions can use in total, and that limit is easy to hit if you have another ad blocker or privacy extension running too. Try turning one of them off, or switch off a list below.

optionsFilterBudgetDetail.message: Your browser says $COUNT$ rule slots are left for all your extensions combined. Still low after turning off other extensions and reloading Moat? Try turning off a list below, Annoyances or Cookie Notices first.

optionsFilterBudgetDropped.message: Turned off for now to stay within your browser's rule limit: $NAMES$.

optionsIndividualListsHint.message: The lists behind "How much to block". Changing one here switches your level to Custom.

optionsBlockedSitesHint.message: Always block these sites, whatever the filter lists say.

optionsAddDomainInvalid.message: That doesn't look like a valid domain.

optionsAddDomainFailed.message: Couldn't add that domain. Try again.

optionsAllowedSitesHint.message: Never block these sites, even when a filter list matches.

optionsHiddenElementsHint.message: Parts of pages you removed with Block an element. Remove one to bring it back.

optionsDimmedElementsHint.message: Elements you grayed out with the picker. Remove one to restore it.

optionsTrackersEmpty.message: No trackers found on the last tab you had open.

optionsTrackersUnsupported.message: This detailed tracker list only works in Chrome for now. Firefox doesn't support it yet.

optionsSyncToggleHint.message: Stored by your browser account. No browsing data is included.

optionsSyncStatusFailed.message: Couldn't sync your settings ($WHEN$). You may have too many custom rules or sites for your browser's sync storage. They're still saved on this device.

presetHintLite.message: Like Essential, without the largest security list.

presetHintStrict.message: Every list, plus all the Privacy extras.

presetHintCustom.message: A mix you've set up yourself.

optionsLiveStatusFailed.message: Last attempt failed ($WHEN$). Still using the built-in list until the next try.

optionsImportedInvalid.message: That file doesn't look like a valid Moat settings export.

leakedPasswordWarning.message: This password has appeared in a known data breach.

popupPermissionGuardIntro.message: Moat's permission guard is blocking prompts on this site:

optionsProtectionDesc.message: What Moat blocks, and what it leaves alone. Everything here runs on your device.

optionsFingerprintDrawerDesc.message: Makes it harder for sites to recognise your computer from its settings.

optionsFingerprintCaution.message: Can occasionally break a CAPTCHA or a bank's device check. If a site misbehaves, turn this off first.

optionsCnameDrawerDesc.message: Finds trackers that hide behind a website's own address.

optionsSearchSlopDrawerDesc.message: Filters known content-farm sites out of your search results.

optionsSearchSlopCaution.message: Each hidden batch stays one click away behind a "Show" link.

optionsLeakedPasswordDrawerDesc.message: Tells you if a password you type has appeared in a data breach.

optionsLeakedPasswordCaution.message: Only a short scrambled piece of it is ever checked.

optionsPermissionGuardMergedDesc.message: Stops pages asking for your camera, microphone or location the moment they load. Allow a site from the popup when you trust it.

optionsFirefoxRFPToggleHint.message: Turns on a deeper device-disguise mode built into Firefox itself. It reaches further than Moat can on its own: window size, fonts, timezone, and more.

optionsFirefoxRFPCaution.message: Can be more disruptive than Moat's own fingerprint protection above. It changes real browser behavior, not just what a page can see, so it's worth trying for a few days before relying on it.

optionsFirefoxFPIToggleLabel.message: Stop trackers linking you across sites

optionsFirefoxFPIToggleHint.message: Keeps every site's stored data separate, so the same tracker embedded on two different sites can't connect what it saw on each.

optionsFirefoxFPICaution.message: Can break logging in with a Google or Facebook account on a third-party site. If a login stops working, pause this first.

optionsFilterListsDesc.message: The rule sets Moat compiles into the browser's own blocker. Every one ships inside the extension itself, so nothing is fetched by your browser to make them work.

optionsCustomRulesDesc.message: Everything you've hidden yourself with the element picker. These override the filter lists and never leave your browser.

optionsRuleAddedMeta.message: Added $DAYS$ days ago · hidden $COUNT$ times since

optionsRuleStaleMeta.message: Hasn't matched in 30 days. The site probably changed.

optionsTrackersDesc.message: Companies Moat stopped this week. Counted on your device and never uploaded.

warningLede.message: Your organization's security policy blocks this site. This isn't Moat's own filter list — it's a domain your organization specifically named.

warningOverrideNote.message: This sends a note to your organization's security team for review — it does not unblock the site.

warningReasonPlaceholder.message: Why do you think this was blocked in error?

warningGoesToIT.message: Goes to your IT team, not to Moat.

warningReportedSuccess.message: Reported to your security team. This page stays blocked until they review it.

warningReportedError.message: Couldn't send the report -- try again in a moment.

welcomeFilterListsTitle.message: Ads, trackers and known-malicious sites blocked

welcomeFilterListsEvidence.message: Balanced filter lists, on by default

welcomeGrayscaleEvidence.message: In-stream ads are grayed out while they play

welcomePopupFirewallEvidence.message: Always on. Hijacked tabs are closed automatically.

welcomeFingerprintEvidence.message: Off by default since it can occasionally affect a CAPTCHA

welcomeLeakedPasswordEvidence.message: Off by default. Only a scrambled fragment of a password ever leaves your device.

welcomeMoreInSettings.message: Both are one click away in Settings.

welcomeShortcutHint.message: toggles protection on and off, anytime.

optionsMigrationImportHint.message: Paste rules exported from uBlock Origin, AdGuard, or similar — blocked/allowed domains and per-site element-hiding rules. Other filter syntax isn't supported and will be skipped.

optionsBackupDesc.message: Keep your settings, rules and paused sites safe, or carry them to another computer.

optionsImportHint.message: Replaces everything below. You'll see what changes before it applies.

optionsAboutDesc.message: What this version is, and everything that ever leaves your device.

optionsDisclosureBlockingSent.message: Nothing. Runs entirely on your device.

optionsDisclosureUpdatesSent.message: One small signed file, downloaded once a day. It carries nothing about you.

optionsDisclosureBreachSent.message: A short scrambled fragment of a password, never the password itself

optionsDisclosureSyncSent.message: Your Moat settings. No browsing data.

optionsDisclosureStatsSent.message: Nothing leaves your device. Counts stay stored locally.

diagnosticsDesc.message: What Moat actually did on the active tab, and what it was supposed to do but didn't.

diagnosticsHeroLabel.message: heuristics that apply here fired on this page load

diagnosticsHeuristicsNote.message: content scripts that read the page. They break when a site changes its markup.

diagnosticsMatchesEmpty.message: No matches recorded yet for this tab. Reload the page and refresh.

optionsImportNoChanges.message: This file matches your current settings. Nothing would change.

levelLead.message: Balanced suits almost everyone. Pick Strict for the most privacy, or Light if a site you use keeps breaking.

levelLightDesc.message: Removes ads, scams and pop-ups. Trackers still load.

levelBalancedDesc.message: Also stops trackers and phishing. Recommended.

levelStrictDesc.message: Also cookie banners and fingerprinting. A few sites may break.

levelCustomNote.message: You're using your own mix of filter lists. Change it under Advanced settings.

featuresLead.message: Ads, trackers and scam pop-ups are always blocked. These are the extras people change most.

pausedEmptyHint.message: Pause a site you trust to let everything load on it.

hiddenEmptyHint.message: Click Moat's icon, choose Block an element, then click what you want gone.

advancedButtonHint.message: Filter lists, privacy extras, your own rules, trackers, backup and version

advBudgetLine.message: Chrome lets all your extensions use $LIMIT$ blocking rules in total. Moat is using $USED$.

advPrivacyLead.message: Extra protection against being followed and identified. Off by default because a few sites can break.

advRulesLead.message: Your own rules. They always win over the filter lists.

advTrackersOnTab.message: On the tab you last used
